requirements.name: A. Core: calculus, linear algebra, analysis foundations
requirements.note: MATH 2A-2B Single-Variable Calculus I-II; MATH 2D Multivariable Calculus I; MATH 3A Linear Algebra; MATH 3D Differential Equations; MATH 9 Programming for Numerical Analysis; MATH 13 Abstract Mathematics; MATH 120A Abstract Algebra: Groups; MATH 121A Linear Algebra I; MATH 130A Probability I; MATH 140A-140B Elementary Analysis I-II

requirements.name: B. Core: one three-quarter science sequence
requirements.note: Select one of: CHEM 1A-1B-1C General Chemistry; PHYSICS 7C-7D-7E Classical Physics; or STATS 7 + MATH 10 + PHYSICS 7C

requirements.name: Pure Mathematics track — Lower-division
requirements.note: Requirements for the Pure Mathematics Major = Core requirements for all Mathematics majors plus the items below

requirements.name: Pure Mathematics track — Upper-division core
requirements.note: MATH 120B Abstract Algebra: Rings and Fields; MATH 121B Linear Algebra II; MATH 147 Complex Analysis

requirements.name: Pure Mathematics track — Five additional MATH electives
requirements.note: Five additional four-unit MATH lecture courses numbered 100–189. Variants NOT encoded here: Applied and Computational Mathematics B.S. is a separate major page; the Mathematics for Education specialization/concentration require application + interview and have their own course lists.
